title: Genetic Conquest (ORIGINAL)
description: This story takes place in a science fiction setting including some alien activity. It focuses on the story of a woman who gives in to her urges instead of doing her job. However, instead of inserting the listener into the experience, you will take a more voyeuristic approach, much as you would reading a story or watching a video. Still completely possible to immerse yourself into the full experience, but without a specific path laid out, you can imagine yourself as any of the players, or fully as a voyeur, watching and enjoying, as a beautiful young ship captain is fucked into senseless bliss by a tentacle monster.
author: Mistress Shibby
